_note: #2632 suppression list for scripts/verify_bundle_boot.py --compare. ONLY probe-environment gaps belong here: a dependency that reaches the Lambda from a LAYER and therefore can never be in the bundle. NOT a place to park a real bundle-shape failure. Every entry is printed on every run. Adding one is a reviewed diff; justify it in the PR.
_note_pillow: Pillow ships as a Lambda layer, never in the code bundle. These four modules import PIL at module scope, so they fail the probe in any environment without Pillow installed - which is the pre-merge lane (it installs pytest/boto3/botocore/black/hypothesis/pyyaml/mypy/ruff and nothing else). On a workstation with Pillow the probe reports 0/397 and these show up as 'now import cleanly'.
